cmElements.minimumChargeMessage: To help customers save more time for life and build a greener world, we will no longer mail electricity bills to customers if the total amount due is less than $150. The summary of your previous bills not exceeding the amount is as follows:

billMsgList.msgOnBill: Message to Customers: This final bill was issued after receiving a request to close this account / new supply application. Any final charges have been deducted from the deposit held in this account (if any). Please settle the outstanding amount as soon as possible to avoid impact to your other account(s) or new accounts move-in in the future. To ensure safety, please turn off the main power switch on your premises. For enquiry, you may contact us via eForm https://clp.to/eform-e.
